name: Circus Inferno
source:
What awaits us after death? Do we cease to exist? Do we go to heaven? Or do we go to hell? What happens if you crossover bendy boys and the divine comedy? Is hell really a bad place?

[From [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/circus-inferno]Indie DB[/url]]
translation:
死亡之后等待我们的是什么？我们会不复存在吗？会去天堂，还是会下地狱？如果把《神曲》和弯曲男孩交叉在一起，会发生什么？地狱真的那么糟糕吗？

[译自[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/circus-inferno]Indie DB[/url]]
